result.title: auth-service runbook
result.body:
h1. auth-service runbook

Owned by team identity (ivan, judy, mallory). Alerts go to #identity-alerts; incidents are discussed in #incidents.

h2. Known failure modes

h3. AuthTokenExpired
Symptom: log lines containing 'AuthTokenExpired: auth token expired mid-request' from validate_token().
Check: error rate panel for service=auth-service; search logs for the trace_id in the alert.
Remediation: roll back the latest deploy of auth-service; if persists, page identity on-call.

h3. IdentityProviderTimeout
Symptom: log lines containing 'IdentityProviderTimeout: identity provider did not respond within 10s' from authenticate().
Check: error rate panel for service=auth-service; search logs for the trace_id in the alert.
Remediation: roll back the latest deploy of auth-service; if persists, page identity on-call.

h2. Dashboards
Chronosphere: rate(http_requests_total{service="auth-service",code=~"5.."}[5m])

remediation: roll back the latest deploy of auth-service; if persists, page identity on-call.

result.body:
h1. auth-service postmortem: AuthTokenExpired recurrence

h2. Summary
Two incidents on auth-service with the same error class AuthTokenExpired: AUTH-117 and AUTH-122, 39 days apart. The first fix (commit 121446e804) did not fully address the root cause; the second incident was resolved with commit 25acaf6a47.

h2. Timeline
* AUTH-117 at 2026-11-11T13:02:00Z
* AUTH-122 at 2026-12-20T13:02:00Z

h2. Follow-ups
See the auth-service runbook and the identity architecture page for context.
